summary: Accepted backend-only UI deprecation decision including status command deprecation and Pi TUI ASCII diagram direction.

diff_table.current_state: Product/system docs and source tests still describe multiple CodeWiki UI surfaces such as Status Dock/Panel, Board, Map, Product, System, and UI navigation.
diff_table.current_project_state: Product/system docs and source tests still describe multiple CodeWiki UI surfaces such as Status Dock/Panel, Board, Map, Product, System, and UI navigation.
diff_table.desired_state: CodeWiki is backend-first for now. Product UI surfaces are deprecated and should not drive package architecture, roadmap acceptance, or tests.
diff_table.agreed_change: Deprecate active product UI docs/surfaces and remove UI-focused acceptance from current backend tasks except where needed to preserve backend command/API behavior.
diff_table.expected_final_state: CodeWiki is backend-first and product UI surfaces are deprecated for this architecture wave.
diff_table.validated_final_state: Approved by user; product overview and terminal docs now say backend-first and UI-deprecated.

Keep status summary as a product UI

diff_table.current_state: Docs imply multiple UI hosts and persistent panels/docks; Pi TUI is one of several surfaces.
diff_table.current_project_state: Docs imply multiple UI hosts and persistent panels/docks; Pi TUI is one of several surfaces.
diff_table.desired_state: The only retained UI direction is Pi TUI as the eventual host-native UI layer; current implementation work should expose backend commands/tools and not build permanent product UI panels.
diff_table.agreed_change: Update product/system docs to say Pi TUI is the sole accepted UI direction, while current work remains backend-only and terminal/tool-command focused.
diff_table.expected_final_state: Pi TUI is the only retained UI direction; backend work remains primary.
diff_table.validated_final_state: Approved by user; product/system terminal docs narrow UI direction to Pi TUI diagram rendering.
diff_table.rationale: This preserves the one explicit UI decision without maintaining deprecated UI docs as active product truth.
alternatives: No UI direction at all
Keep CLI-only forever

diff_table.current_state: System diagram docs mention visual navigation and graph/map surfaces; rendering target is not crisply constrained.
diff_table.current_project_state: System diagram docs mention visual navigation and graph/map surfaces; rendering target is not crisply constrained.
diff_table.desired_state: System diagrams remain canonical YAML/source truth and may be rendered in ASCII inside Pi TUI. No browser UI, status panel/dock, Board, Map, Product, or System product UI surface is active now.
diff_table.agreed_change: Narrow diagram rendering requirement to ASCII output in Pi TUI from canonical diagram YAML; remove or archive broader UI navigation promises.
diff_table.expected_final_state: Only ASCII/Unicode Pi TUI diagram rendering from canonical system diagram YAML remains as UI direction.
diff_table.validated_final_state: Approved by user; terminal docs now constrain diagram rendering to canonical YAML and ASCII/Unicode output.
diff_table.rationale: ASCII diagram rendering gives enough human visibility while keeping backend architecture primary.
alternatives: Render Mermaid/SVG
Keep graph/map navigation UI

diff_table.current_project_state: TASK-089 includes Status Dock cleanup and UI wording work because of an incorrect interpretation of deprecated Status Panel.
diff_table.desired_state: TASK-089 should focus backend/source cleanup: skills, validation root removal, Decision Table clean cut, prompt/tool contracts, and UI deprecation rather than Status Dock-as-product-UI work.
diff_table.agreed_change: Revise TASK-089 evidence/acceptance and source changes to remove Status Dock-as-product-UI work, replacing it with backend-only and UI-deprecation cleanup.
diff_table.expected_final_state: TASK-089 tracks backend cleanup and UI deprecation; it does not promote Status Dock as a product UI.

diff_table.current_state: The package still exposes /wiki status and legacy /wiki-status as UI/status-surface commands, and tests/docs expect status panel/dock rendering.
diff_table.current_project_state: The package still exposes /wiki status and legacy /wiki-status as UI/status-surface commands, and tests/docs expect status panel/dock rendering.
diff_table.desired_state: Status UI commands are deprecated. Backend status remains available through tools/API/state lenses such as wiki_state, but no /wiki status, /wiki-status, or /wiki_status UI command should remain a promoted user surface.
diff_table.agreed_change: Deprecate /wiki status, /wiki-status, and /wiki_status surfaces; remove status-panel/dock rendering expectations from tests/docs, and route backend status/readiness needs through wiki_state or non-UI API/tool outputs.
diff_table.expected_final_state: Status UI command surfaces are deprecated and not promoted; backend status is served by wiki_state/graph lenses.
diff_table.validated_final_state: Approved by user; status command docs and adapter behavior are being narrowed to deprecation messaging.
diff_table.rationale: If all UI is deprecated for now, status command UI must not survive as a renamed panel/dock path. Backend state remains needed, UI shell does not.
alternatives: Keep /wiki status as a backend JSON/status command only
Keep legacy /wiki-status as hidden compatibility command

/wiki status, /wiki-status, and /wiki_status status UI commands are deprecated; backend status uses wiki_state and graph lenses.
